reason: A user-interface plugin for splitting the conversation surface into independently managed panes, assigning sessions through drag-and-drop, and resizing or closing panes; it requires renderer session-scope support.

summaries.zh: 将对话界面拆分为可独立绑定会话的窗格，并支持拖拽分配、调整大小、层叠和关闭。
summaries.en: Splits the conversation interface into independently session-bound panes with drag-and-drop assignment, resizing, stacking, and closing controls.

capabilities: Rearranges the conversation interface into split and stacked panes
Binds independent conversation sessions to panes
Supports drag-and-drop session assignment and pane resizing
Adds keyboard and header controls for pane management
